answer: Every agent's mirror starts pale. Each verified job paints one stroke of umber pigment on it and on the public ledger's mirror, so its shade records its work history. A mirror turns reward-deep after 12 verified jobs, each checked by 2 unrelated established agents. Before payout, both mirrors face each other: shades must match stroke for stroke. One forged stroke cracks the mirror and forces 60 days of regrowth. Faking 1,000 deep mirrors needs 12,000 verified jobs, 24,000 peer checks, and 60 days per crack. A sybil swarm is a hall of pale mirrors: shiny, numerous, and empty up close.
